span.p:
① nodeToTask()
─────────────────
For each BasePOI node
where properties.buem ≠ null
─────────────────
Topology node → GeoJSON Feature
Coordinates lifted to geometry
start_time / end_time injected

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
② POST /api/process
─────────────────
GeoJSON Feature
→ buem-service:5000
?include_timeseries=true
─────────────────
5R1C thermal solver runs
8 760-step simulation

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
③ extractWriteAndAnnotate()
─────────────────
Timeseries arrays → CSV files
Arrays stripped from response
CSV file paths injected

─────────────────

replaces original node's
